lakes.note: polygons: the Environment Agency's WFD lakes. lake: index into lakes; null when no monitored overflow upstream reaches it; -1 when the lake has no river connection in the network (isolated). lakes[].inlets: where water enters the lake, and o = flat triples (overflow index, distance along the network m, dilution x 10000 before dividing by 1 + area / 5 km2); k = flat triples (overflow index, metres of another WFD lake crossed on the way, which travel at the lake velocity, lake factor x 1000000 to multiply the dilution by) for the overflows in o whose water crosses one; h = flat quadruples (lake path residence: overflow index, metres of those lakes with a residence time, which do not travel at the lake velocity, survivors' hours in them x 1000 added to the travel time, share alive x 1000000000 to multiply the die-off by).
